    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPork & chive dumplingsEverybody relax, I'm hereHow to make it400g pork mince1 bunch garlic chives, chopped10g ginger, grated1 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp Shaoxing wine1 tsp sesame oil30 dumpling wrappers2 tbsp vegetable oil100ml water1 tbsp black vinegar1 tbsp chilli oilMix the pork with the chives, ginger, soy, Shaoxing and sesame oil.Pleat spoonfuls into the dumpling wrappers.Fry until the bottoms crisp.Add the water and steam with the lid on.Serve with vinegar and chilli oil.Salt & pepper squidThunder, Rain and LightningHow to make it500g squid tubes100g potato starch1 tsp salt1 tsp white pepper1 pinch five spice1 L vegetable oil for frying3 garlic cloves, sliced2 red chillies, sliced2 spring onions, slicedScore the squid and cut into strips.Toss in the starch with salt, white pepper and five spice.Heat the vegetable oil to 190°C and fry in batches until crisp.Wok-toss with fried garlic, red chillies and spring onion.MainsWang Chi's beef ho funFast hands. It's all in the reflexesHow to make it400g beef rump, thinly sliced3 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp cornflour3 tbsp vegetable oil800g fresh flat rice noodles1 brown onion, sliced4 spring onions, cut into lengths200g bean sprouts2 tbsp dark soy sauce1 tsp sugarToss the beef with 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, the cornflour and 1 tbsp of the oil, and leave for 15 minutes.Loosen the noodles by hand under warm water and drain well.Sear the beef in a smoking hot wok with 1 tbsp of the oil for 1 minute, then tip it out.Fry the onion in the last of the oil, add the noodles and toss over high heat until they catch at the edges.Add the rest of the soy sauce, the dark soy and sugar, then the beef, bean sprouts and spring onion, and toss for 1 minute. Serve straight away.Pork-Chop Express ribsStraight off Jack's truckHow to make it1.5kg pork ribs4 tbsp hoisin sauce2 tbsp honey2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp five spice1 cube red fermented bean curd3 garlic cloves, crushedMix the hoisin, honey, soy, five spice, bean curd and garlic and rub over the ribs.Marinate in the fridge overnight, at least 8 hours.Roast covered at 160°C.Uncover, glaze and blast at 220°C until sticky.Rest briefly before serving.House fried riceChang Sing or Wing Kong, all order itHow to make it600g cooked jasmine rice, a day old3 eggs2 tbsp vegetable oil100g frozen peas2 tbsp soy sauce1/2 tsp white pepper4 spring onions, sliced1 tsp sesame oilCook 240g jasmine rice ahead (the day before is best), spread it out and chill. Cold rice fries and holds better.Beat the eggs and scramble them softly in a hot wok with half the oil, then tip them out.Fry the rice in the rest of the oil over high heat, breaking up the clumps, until it starts to toast.Add the peas, soy sauce and white pepper, then the egg and spring onion, and finish with the sesame oil.Garlic gai lanGreen as Miao Yin's eyesHow to make it2 bunches of gai lan4 garlic cloves, sliced1 tbsp vegetable oil1 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sugar2 tbsp waterTrim the gai lan and halve any thick stems.Blanch in boiling salted water for 1 minute and drain.Fry the garlic in the oil until golden, then toss the gai lan through with the soy, sugar and water for 1 minute.SweetsFortune cookiesJack would ignore his anywayHow to make it3 egg whites100g caster sugar60g plain flour40g butter, melted1 tsp vanilla extract12 paper fortunesWrite 12 fortunes on thin paper strips, two of each: It's all in the reflexes. Green eyes mean big trouble. Never lend out your truck. The bag holds six things, don't ask. Pay what you owe before you go underground. Somebody at this table owes you twenty bucks.Whisk the egg whites with the sugar, then stir in the flour, butter and vanilla.Spread 8cm circles on a lined tray, a few at a time.Bake at 180°C.Working fast, fold each around a paper fortune while hot.DrinksEgg Shen's magic potionThe flask for the trip belowHow to make it50g sugar50ml water20g ginger, sliced240ml plum wine60ml lemon juice1 egg white4 pickled plums or cherries1 bag iceSimmer the sugar, water and ginger, then cool and strain.Shake the plum wine, lemon juice, ginger syrup and egg white hard without ice, then with ice.Strain into 4 ice-filled glasses and garnish with a pickled plum.
